declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K2: for every action: each violation changes exactly one fact and it is the dropped coordinate, every violation is refused, distinct coordinates give distinct messages, and the same coordinate under a different distractor gives the same message
declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K3: one refusal per coordinate leaves exactly one distinct behaviour, and it is the true precondition
declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K4: every refusal leaves the tree byte-identical
declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K5: every action is identified with 1 success + k refusals, against 160 state interventions and 0

limits: the fact vector is measured with the program's own check where one exists (tar -tzf, gzip -t, patch --dry-run, git diff --quiet), and at least one of those checks is measurably narrower than the fact it is used for -- recorded in K2, not hidden
ten actions, one machine, one producer; a census of these ten
the fact vector is hand-written: the agent must be given (or construct) the nine facts a state is described by, and no refusal tells it which facts exist -- this is the reach bottleneck, restated
the message is normalised by a declared rewrite (paths and distractor names out); the rewrite is a part and it is counted as one, while injectivity and invariance are measured on what remains
identification is up to the states measured: one distinct behaviour over these states, not over the world
some real failures are destructive; this sample's are not, and K4 measures that rather than assuming it
a refusal names a missing fact; it does not say how to obtain it, and nothing here builds the remedy

K4_the_failure_is_free.claim: a refusal does not touch the objects under the action; anything it does write is its own bookkeeping, and that is counted rather than assumed away

why_this_round.the_answer_being_tested: a refusal message is a function of the violated precondition coordinate, so the precondition is declared by the program rather than sampled by the agent
why_this_round.the_gap_it_closes: the tree measured that a success identifies applicability 0/200, that the precondition is not in the trace (160 states, 0 identified, best accuracy 1.0), and that a check mode is an oracle (1.0 held-out) -- but every one of those used a supplied fact vocabulary and none asked what a REFUSAL is
why_this_round.why_it_could_fail: messages may collide across coordinates, may vary with distractors, may name a cause that is not a precondition, or a refusal may not be free (a partial effect)
